method: In the running: the row gave an offer an agent can pay on the newest sheet of its market, with a price per request in US dollars (USDC on a main network for x402; for MPP a charge in one of the dollar currencies listed in MPP_USD), at or under the budget when one is given, and its BM25 match to the job is at least half the best match among rows in the running.
Price: the cheapest dollar option of an answer; when the endpoint was asked twice, the higher of the two answers' cheapest options, the price a buyer may be asked.
Order: honest (0 asked what it lists, 1 not judged, 2 asked more or another pay-to), then delivery (0 a Fair Offer block, 1 none), then price, then match (higher first), then the resource, as text.
Match: Okapi BM25 with k1 1.2 and b 0.75 over the rows ranked together, idf ln(1 + (N - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5)), each job word counted once, scores rounded to 6 places.

Words: lower case runs of a-z and 0-9 from the listing's description, name, tags and address, stop words and words of one letter or only digits dropped, a light suffix rule (ies to y; ches, shes, sses, xes, zes lose es; ing and ed dropped; a final s dropped unless ss, us or is), each word at most 3 times, the 64 most frequent kept (ties by the word), published sorted.
